'''Thorsten Schmidt''' (born 14 October 1978) is a German [[rowing (sport)|rower]]. He competed in the [[Rowing at the 2000 Summer Olympics – Men's lightweight coxless four|men's lightweight coxless four]] event at the [[2000 Summer Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/sc/thorsten-schmidt-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200417222737/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/sc/thorsten-schmidt-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=17 April 2020 |title=Thorsten Schmidt Olympic Results |access-date=24 September 2018}}</ref>
